Subject: Quarter close: Stage lockdown & hygiene — action required

Team,

Quick reminder as we enter the final week of Q3: we are moving to a stage-lockdown cadence to finalize the forecast. Two asks — please prioritize these before EOD Friday: 

1) Update opportunity stages to the canonical pipeline states (Prospect / Qualified / Proposal / Commit / Closed) — no custom interim stages.
2) Flag any at-risk ACV in the red/yellow/green sheet and attach a one-line save plan for red and yellow items.

I attached a template redlist (HB-4721_redlist.csv) and a short save-plan PDF for reference. Markus, finance needs a locked forecast snapshot by 12pm PT Monday — if you foresee any slippage please call it out now.

We will run a live to-the-line review on Monday morning; owners must have stage and commit fields accurate beforehand. If you are blocked by an external PO / legal hold, mark the deal with the special tag "action:external-block" in HubSpot and paste the link in the sheet.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, West Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: HB-4721_redlist.csv, forecast_lock_instructions.txt

Marissa —

Acknowledged. Quick update for HB-4721 (Hive Analytics):
- Stage: Proposal -> I moved it to Commit after the internal exec sponsorship confirmation yesterday.
- ACV: $425k (annual) — still expect signature but procurement at Hive has one outstanding question on our data retention options. Emma from Hive is included here; she and I are coordinating a short procurement review with Acme (their vendor team) tomorrow.

Action items I have posted in the redlist: the procurement blocker is currently a yellow (timed risk). I attached a one-line save plan: "Offer 12-month controlled retention SLA + optional on-prem bundle trial; escalate to legal for SOC addendum fast-track."

If procurement stalls after tomorrow, I'll mark the deal red and propose the contingency (2-week extension + partial revenue recognition plan).

-David
